basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old from Michigan, currently working as a software developer. I recently got into gaming, especially Dead by Daylight. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new games and sharing strategies with fellow gamers. I tend to be online in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and love spending time with my dog, Max. I dislike toxic gaming environments but enjoy strategic discussions and learning new tactics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, with a Bachelor's degree from a local university. My interest in gaming started a few months ago, and I've been learning through YouTube tutorials and Reddit threads. Most of my knowledge comes from community discussions and trial and error in gameplay.
